author: nickyeow

english.text: Tell us the story from beginning to end.

jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 zoeng1 go3 gu3 si6 jau4 tau4 dou3 mei5 gong2 saai3 bei2 ngo5 dei6 teng1。
text: 唔該你將個故事由頭到尾講晒俾我地聽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "What happened to your nose?" "When I was backing my car up I went to check behind me, convinced that the car window was open, and bashed my face into it!"

jyutping: 「nei5 go3 bei6 gaau2 me1 aa3？」「ngo5 tau4 sin1 tan3 hau6 gaa3 ce1 go2 zan6，nam2 zyu6 san1 go3 tau2 ceot1 heoi3 tai2 cing1 co2 hau6 min6 jau5 mou4 jan4。ngo5 ji5 go3 ce1 coeng1 hoi1 zyu6 laa1，dim2 zi1 jyun4 loi4 saan1 zo2 wo3，jyu1 si6 zau6 seng4 go3 tau2 zong6 zo2 le1 go3 coeng1 dou6 laa3。」
text: 「你個鼻搞咩呀？」「我頭先褪後架車嗰陣，諗住伸個頭出去睇清楚後面有無人。我以個車窗開住啦，點知原來閂咗喎，於是就成個頭撞咗哩個窗度喇。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want to sleep a little more.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 fan3 do1 zan6。
text: 我想瞓多陣。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I usually go home at four.

jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 sei3 dim2 faan1 uk1 kei2。
text: 我通常四點返屋企。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I have a stomachache.

jyutping: ngo5 go3 tou5 hou2 tung3。
text: 我個肚好痛。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I would often take part in an English speech contest in my school days.

jyutping: ngo5 duk6 syu1 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 caam1 gaa1 jing1 man2 jin2 gong2 bei2 coi3。
text: 我讀書嗰陣成日參加英文演講比賽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Give us two knives and four forks, please.

jyutping: m4 goi1 bei2 loeng5 baa2 dou1 tung4 maai4 sei3 zi1 caa1 ngo5 dei6 aa1。
text: 唔該俾兩把刀同埋四支叉我哋吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Latin is the language of the future!

jyutping: laai1 ding1 man4 hai6 mei6 loi4 ge3 jyu5 jin4！
text: 拉丁文係未來嘅語言！

author: fercheung

english.text: Who is playing the piano?

jyutping: bin1 go3 hai2 dou6 taan4 kam4 aa3？
text: 邊個喺度彈琴呀？

author: fercheung

english.text: Everybody knows for sure that it was he who did it.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 cing1 co2 ne1 gin6 si6 jat1 ding6 hai6 keoi5 zou6 ge3。
text: 我哋大家都好清楚呢件事一定係佢做嘅。

author: kaenif

english.text: The noise set the dog barking.

jyutping: di1 cou3 jam1 gaau2 dou3 zek3 gau2 hai2 dou6 fai6。
text: 啲噪音搞到隻狗喺度吠。

author: kaenif

english.text: I'm going to Paris tomorrow.

jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 baa1 lai4。
text: 我聽日去巴黎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Will you cook something for me?

jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zyu2 di1 je5 bei2 ngo5 sik6 aa3？
text: 你可唔可以煮啲嘢俾我食呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom has asked us to buy him something to eat.

jyutping: aa3 Tom giu3 ngo5 dei6 maai5 di1 je5 bei2 keoi5 sik6。
text: 阿Tom叫我哋買啲嘢俾佢食。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What do you want Santa to bring you for Christmas?

jyutping: nei5 soeng2 sing3 daan3 lou5 jan4 sung3 me1 lai5 mat6 bei2 nei5 aa3？
text: 你想聖誕老人送咩禮物俾你呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He's a shitty driver.

jyutping: keoi5 sau2 ce1 hou2 si2。
text: 佢手車好屎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Wealth breeds arrogance.

jyutping: coi4 fu3 ling6 jan4 zi6 daai6。
text: 財富令人自大。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm a newcomer.

jyutping: ngo5 san1 lai4 gaa3。
text: 我新嚟㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm in a good mood.

jyutping: ngo5 sam1 cing4 hou2 leng3。
text: 我心情好靚。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: Look at that!
Look there!

jyutping: tai2 go2 dou6！
text: 睇嗰度！

author: nickyeow

english.text: She said she didn't want to worry me.

jyutping: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 ngo5 daam1 sam1。
text: 佢話佢唔想我擔心。

author: cheeseisdisgusting

english.text: I was wondering where this extra pair of chopsticks came from.

jyutping: ngo5 zau6 hai2 dou6 nam2 gan2 dim2 gaai2 wui5 do1 deoi3 faai3 zi2 ge3？
text: 我就喺度諗緊點解會多對筷子嘅？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I expected you to say more.

jyutping: ngo5 jam6 zyu6 nei5 wui5 gong2 do1 di1 gaa1 maa3。
text: 我恁住你會講多啲加嘛。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom was scared to go outside.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 m4 gam2 ceot1 heoi3。
text: 阿湯唔敢出去。

author: FishlandicFishy

english.text: Does he know Italian?

jyutping: keoi5 sik1 m4 sik1 ji6 daai6 lei6 man4 ne1？
text: 佢識唔識義大利文呢？

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Leatherbacks are the world’s largest turtles. They can grow more than two meters long and weigh more than four-hundred kilograms. But they do not have hard, protective shells like most turtles. Their backs are covered with oily, ribbed skin.

jyutping: pei4 bui3 gwai1 hai6 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 gwai1，keoi5 dei6 ge3 coeng4 ciu1 gwo3 loeng5 mai5，ji4 zung6 ciu1 gwo3 sei3 baak3 gung1 gan1，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 mou5 hou2 ci5 daai6 bou6 fan6 gwai1 gam2 jau5 ngaang6 di1 ge3 bou2 wu6 hok3。
text: 皮背龜係世界上最大嘅龜，佢哋嘅長超過兩米，而重超過四百公斤，但係佢哋冇好似大部分龜噉有硬啲嘅保護殼。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Kevyn was an online Filipino friend who lived in my North American metropolis. He was an enthusiast of conlangs, such as Toki Pona and Elefen. He wrote a poem in my own conlang Vong. Dear to him was the comparative deep study of religions. He grew up Roman Catholic, but later grew to like Hinduism. In his religious studies, he did not neglect the sexual aspect. I noticed that he had an Oriental face.

jyutping: Kevyn hai6 jat1 go3 mong5 soeng6 ge3 fei1 leot6 ban1 pang4 jau5，keoi5 zyu6 hai2 ngo5 ge3 bak1 mei5 daai6 dou1 wui5。keoi5 hai6 hong1 long5 ge3 oi3 hou3 ze2，lai6 jyu4 dung1 muk6 bo1 naap6 tung4 aai1 loi4 fan1。keoi5 hai2 ngo5 zi6 gei2 ge3 hong1 long5 fung4 dou6 se2 zo2 jat1 sau2 si1。keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 hai6 deoi3 zung1 gaau3 ge3 bei2 gaau3 sam1 jap6 jin4 gau3。keoi5 hai2 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 tou4 zoeng2 daai6，daan6 hai6 hau6 loi4 hoi1 ci2 zung1 ji3 jan3 dou6 gaau3。hai2 keoi5 ge3 zung1 gaau3 jin4 gau3 jap6 min6，keoi5 mou5 fat1 loek6 sing3 fong1 min6。ngo5 lau4 ji3 dou3 keoi5 jau5 go3 dung1 fong1 jan4 ge3 min6 hung2。
text: Kevyn 係一個網上嘅菲律賓朋友，佢住喺我嘅北美大都會。佢係康朗嘅愛好者，例如東木波納同埃萊芬。佢喺我自己嘅康朗馮度寫咗一首詩。佢最鍾意嘅係對宗教嘅比較深入研究。佢喺羅馬天主教徒長大，但係後來開始鍾意印度教。喺佢嘅宗教研究入面，佢冇忽略性方面。我留意到佢有個東方人嘅面孔。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: A DEA officer stops at a ranch in Texas. He tells the rancher, "I need to inspect your ranch for illegally grown drugs." The rancher says, "Okay, but do not go in that field over there," as he points out the location. The DEA officer verbally explodes, "Mister, I have the authority of the Federal Government with me." Reaching into his rear pants pocket, he takes out his badge and proudly displays it to the rancher. "See this badge? This badge means I am allowed to go wherever I wish. On any land. No questions asked or answers given. Have I made myself clear? Do you understand?" The rancher nods politely, apologizes, and goes about his chores. A short while later, the old rancher hears loud screams and sees the DEA officer running for his life, chased by the rancher's big angry bull... With every step, the bull is gaining ground on the officer, and it seems likely that he'll get gored before he reaches safety. The officer is clearly terrified. The rancher throws down his tools, runs to the fence and yells at the top of his lungs, "Your badge! Show him your fucking badge!"

jyutping: jau5 go3 cap1 duk6 guk6（DEA）ge3 taam3 jyun4 hai2 dak1 zau1 jat1 go3 muk6 coeng4 ting4 dai1。keoi5 hou2 daai6 hau2 hei3 gam2 tung4 go3 muk6 coeng4 zyu2 jan4 gong2：「ngo5 jiu3 sau2 caa4 nei5 go3 muk6 coeng4，tai2 haa2 nei5 jau5 mou5 fei1 faat3 zung3 zik6 duk6 ban2。」lou5 muk6 coeng4 zyu2 jan4 daap3 keoi5：「mou5 man6 tai4，daan6 nei5 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 heoi3 go2 bin1 go2 faai3 cou2 dei6 aa3。」keoi5 zi2 zyu6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 fong1 hoeng3。go3 taam3 jyun4 jat1 teng1 zik1 hak1「baau3 hei3」：「sin1 saang1，ngo5 doi6 biu2 gan2 lyun4 bong1 zing3 fu2 ge3 kyun4 wai1！」keoi5 jau4 hau6 fu3 doi6 lo2 go3 wai2 jam6 zing3 ceot1 lai4，hou2 san4 hei3 gam2 hai2 go3 lou5 muk6 coeng4 zyu2 jan4 min2 cin4 fong2 loeng5 fong2：「gin3 m4 gin3 dou2 go3 zing3 aa3？ni1 go3 zing3 doi6 biu2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 heoi3 jam6 ho4 ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 ge3 dei6 fong1。jam6 ho4 tou2 dei6。m4 sai2 man6 man6 tai4，jik6 dou1 m4 sai2 hoeng3 jan4 gaau1 doi6。ngo5 gong2 dak1 gau3 m4 gau3 cing1 co2？nei5 ming4 m4 ming4 aa3？」lou5 muk6 coeng4 zyu2 jan4 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6 gam2 dim2 dim2 tau4，dou6 zo2 go3 hip3，zau6 gai3 zuk6 heoi3 zou6 keoi5 di1 nung4 wut6。gwo3 zo2 mou5 noi2，lou5 muk6 coeng4 zyu2 jan4 teng1 dou3 jat1 zan6 hou2 cai1 lai6 ge3 zim1 giu3 seng1，jat1 toi4 tau4 zau6 gin3 dou2 go3 taam3 jyun4 bok3 meng6 paau2 gan2，hau6 min6 jau5 jat1 zek3 ciu1 kap1 fan5 nou6 ge3 daai6 gung1 ngau4 zeoi1 zyu6 keoi5，soeng2 lo2 keoi5 meng6 gam2 fun2。mui5 paau2 jat1 bou6，zek3 gung1 ngau4 zau6 laai1 gan6 jat1 dim2 keoi5 lei4，ngaan5 gin3 go3 taam3 jyun4 mei6 paau2 dou3 on1 cyun4 dei6 fong1，zau6 hang2 ding6 wui5 bei2 ngau4 gok3 caap3 cyun1。go3 taam3 jyun4 haak3 dou3 wan4 fei1 paak3 saan3。go3 lou5 muk6 coeng4 zyu2 jan4 zik1 hak1 dap6 dai1 sau2 soeng6 di1 gaa3 saang1，paau2 heoi3 wai4 laan4 bin1 jung6 zeon6 cyun4 san1 lik6 hei3 daai6 giu3：「go3 zing3 aa3！lo2 nei5 go3 sei2 jan4 wai2 jam6 zing3 bei2 keoi5 tai2 aa3！！」
text: 有個緝毒局（DEA）嘅探員喺德州一個牧場停低。佢好大口氣噉同個牧場主人講：「我要搜查你個牧場，睇吓你有冇非法種植毒品。」老牧場主人答佢：「冇問題，但你千祈唔好去嗰邊嗰塊草地呀。」佢指住其中一個方向。個探員一聽即刻「爆氣」：「先生，我代表緊聯邦政府嘅權威！」佢由後褲袋攞個委任證出嚟，好神氣噉喺個老牧場主人面前晃兩晃：「見唔見到個證呀？呢個證代表我可以去任何我想去嘅地方。任何土地。唔使問問題，亦都唔使向人交代。我講得夠唔夠清楚？你明唔明呀？」老牧場主人好有禮貌噉點點頭，道咗個歉，就繼續去做佢啲農活。過咗冇耐，老牧場主人聽到一陣好淒厲嘅尖叫聲，一抬頭就見到個探員搏命跑緊，後面有一隻超級憤怒嘅大公牛追住佢，想攞佢命噉款。每跑一步，隻公牛就拉近一點距離，眼見個探員未跑到安全地方，就肯定會畀牛角插穿。個探員嚇到魂飛魄散。個老牧場主人即刻揼低手上啲架生，跑去圍欄邊用盡全身力氣大叫：「個證呀！攞你個死人委任證畀佢睇呀！！」
